title: The New Library
description: Three short recordings about a new library: two friends, a librarian and a phone message.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Two friends
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and Tom talking about the new library.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Tom, have you seen the new library? It opened last Monday.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Not yet, Linh. Where is it? I think we should go there together soon, because all our friends talk about it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: It's next to the sports centre, opposite the bakery. It's a big yellow building.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Is it open at the weekend?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, but only on Saturday. It closes at four o'clock. On school days it's open until six.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Great. Let's go on Saturday morning. No, wait, I have football then. We can go in the afternoon.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: OK. I want to borrow a book about dolphins.

parts.title: Part 2 · The librarian
parts.intro: You will hear a librarian, Mrs Hill, talking to a class.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Welcome to our new library, everyone. I'm Mrs Hill, the librarian.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: You can borrow four books at the same time, and you can keep them for two weeks.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Please speak quietly, and don't eat or drink in the library. If you are thirsty, there is a water machine outside. Thank you for helping to keep it a nice place for everybody to read.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: On the first floor there are books for young children. The computers are upstairs, on the second floor.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Every Wednesday at four o'clock there is a story club. This week a man will read a funny story about a dragon.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear Nam leave a message for his sister, Mai.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hi, Mai. It's Nam. I'm at the new library now, and it's brilliant!

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I'm looking for the book you want, but there are two other books about space. Shall I borrow them for you?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Oh, and I can't find my library card. I think it's at home, on my desk. Can you ask Mum to look?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I'll be home at five o'clock. Please don't forget to feed the fish. Bye! It's raining here, so I'm going to wait inside until Dad comes to get me.
